headline: Websites your customers use,
{and the systems behind them.}
hero.intro: Ostendic designs and builds websites and web applications, and sets up AI workflows that handle the follow-ups, routing and admin that happen after a customer gets in touch.

services.heading: Two things we do, and do properly

web-development.summary: Websites and web apps that explain what you do, work well on a phone, and make it easy to get in touch or buy.
web-development.who: You need a new website, a better one, or a web app your customers use.
web-development.problem: Visitors can’t tell what you do, or how to get in touch. So they leave.
web-development.build: Business websites, landing pages, online stores, Shopify and WordPress sites, custom web apps, redesigns.
includes: Planning the pages and the visitor’s path
Design for phone, tablet and desktop
A custom build, or WordPress and Shopify

agentic-ai-workflows.summary: AI workflows that connect your tools and take the repetitive work off your team.
agentic-ai-workflows.who: Teams stuck repeating manual steps: answering enquiries, chasing leads, copying data between tools.
agentic-ai-workflows.problem: Leads wait for a reply. Questions pile up. Someone spends hours moving data from one tool to another.
agentic-ai-workflows.build: AI agents for business operations, lead follow-up, support workflows, process automation, tool integrations.
includes: Designing it, including where a person approves
Building it and connecting it to your tools
Testing on real cases before going live

steps.title: Talk it through
steps.text: Tell us what’s not working. We’ll say if we can’t help.

steps.title: Agree it in writing
steps.text: Scope, price and dates on paper before any work starts.

steps.title: Build, with check-ins
steps.text: You see progress at set points, not just at the end.

steps.title: Launch and hand over
steps.text: You get the logins and notes to run it yourself.

about.heading: We build the online side of your business,
about.headingItalic: so you can run the rest.
paragraphs: Ostendic builds websites and AI agentic workflows for businesses that want to look credible and run smoothly.
Your site brings people in. Your workflows handle what happens next. We build both, and hand them over so your team can run them.
